description: This script defines several utility functions for system process checking, MAC address retrieval, log synchronization, system reboot, and uptime reporting, primarily intended for system initialization or management tasks.

methods.name: processCheck
methods.description: Checks if a process with the given name is running by using ps and grep.

methods.name: getMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the interface specified by the environment variable ESTB_INTERFACE.

methods.name: syncLog
methods.description: Synchronizes log files from a temporary log directory to a persistent log directory, concatenating and clearing logs as needed.

methods.name: rebootFunc
methods.description: Performs system shutdown procedures, including saving power state, syncing logs, and rebooting.

methods.name: Uptime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in seconds by reading /proc/uptime and processing it with awk.
